summary: Verified the new Clan Hub feature batch (announcement, role-colored bubbles + own-alignment, @mentions, reactions, profile cards, member live status, Resumen achievements/missions, Estadisticas leaderboard, Territorios mini-map + turf history, banner). Backend: 7/7 pytest tests passed against public endpoints. Frontend: all data-testids present and interactive on the /clanes route using demo login token.

issues: Page-level vertical scroll ~599px because the mini-map/turf panels are tall. Body scrollHeight=1463 vs viewport 864. Not blocking, and horizontal overflow is 0, but the user requirement asked for 'minimal vertical page scroll on /clanes' -- consider reducing the mini-map height or making the left column internally scroll on shorter desktop viewports.

action_items: (Nice-to-have) Constrain the Territorios tab left column height (mini-map) so total /clanes page fits ~ viewport at 1536x864 (currently ~600px page overflow).
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/clans.py is 887 lines - approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting router endpoints, chat, insights, and admin sections into submodules.

do_react allows a client-supplied emoji string up to 8 chars but does not restrict to a whitelist -- users could store arbitrary short strings as 'reactions'. Consider validating against an allowed emoji set.
GET /api/clans/me returns the full ranks + settings block on every call; response is large for a hot dashboard endpoint. Consider trimming for the hub page or splitting into /me and /me/config.
get_insights recomputes counts on every call (count_documents x3 + full members list). For a hot dashboard, a short (5-10s) per-clan memoization would reduce Mongo load.
test_credentials: POST /api/auth/demo -> token; set localStorage.primal_token; demo user is LEADER of clan TEST (Escuadron Prueba). See /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Announcement mutated during test then cleared. A couple TEST_CHAT_* messages left in clan history (harmless).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints /api/clans/me, /insights, /turf-history, /announcement, /react, /chat are all healthy. Demo clan has territories=3, wins=7, 16 members with status_text/level/contribution/kills, leaderboard has 10 rows, turf-history has 6 events, mini-map renders 10 zones. Frontend uses data-testids: toptab-{chat,miembros,resumen,estadisticas,territorios,turfwars}, clan-announcement, announcement-{edit,input,save}, chat-{input,send}, mention-list + mention-<Name>, react-btn-<id>/react-<id>-<emoji>/reaction-chip-<id>-<emoji>, member-avatar-<uid>, profile-card-<uid>, achievements-panel + achievement-<id>, missions-panel + mission-<id>, leaderboard-panel + lb-<uid>, turf-minimap + zone-<id>, turf-history + turf-event-<i>, attack-alert.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A - no functional defects found. Only a minor layout observation on the Territorios tab height.
